'''Divas''',<ref name="CSWE Divas" /> also called the '''order of the Divas''',<ref name="DB Funquita">{{DB|character|divafunquita|Funquita, Diva}}</ref> were a religious order of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Theelin/Legends|Theelin]] singers, known for their [[Opera/Legends|operatic]] forms<ref name="CSWE Divas" /> which were considered the standard against which other vocal performances were measured.<ref name="DB Shaliqua">{{DB|character|divashaliqua|Shaliqua, Diva}}</ref>

As the Theelin population began to dwindle<ref name="CSWE Divas" /> due to a genetic mutation<ref name="DB Shaliqua" /> toward the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> many Theelin were named "Diva" at birth in the hopes that they would grow up to continue the tradition.<ref name="CSWE Divas" /> Some of the works considered the most powerful and stirring in Theelin history were created during this [[Time/Legends|time]]. The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Ingoda]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Theelins, and considered having possible Divas as slaves to be "lucrative."<ref name="DB Shaliqua" />

Notable Divas during this era were [[Diva Arroquitas]],<ref name="DBArroquitas">{{DB|character|divaarroquitas|Arroquitas, Diva}}</ref> [[Diva Funquita/Legends|Diva Funquita]],<ref name="DB Funquita" /> and [[Diva Shaliqua/Legends|Diva Shaliqua]],<ref name="DB Shaliqua" />
